problem.title: Find the Lowest Common Ancestor of Multiple Nodes in a Binary Search Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree and a set of K distinct keys, determine their lowest common ancestor.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST. • The following line contains K. • The last line contains K distinct keys.
problem.output: • Print the value of the lowest common ancestor.
